manaNeeded: {1} if you don't control an Elemental
notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Elemental you control.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
